Jamie: Heads-up: temporary change to canary allocations in us-west-2 for the next ~2 hours due to intermittent v3 text-gen tail-latency spikes. Please read if you're running rollouts now. :rotating_light:

Jamie: Immediate changes:
- Block new canaries for `text-gen-highmem` in us-west-2.
- Evict canaries with label `exp/low` to free 2 slots.
- Reassign one freed slot to `embeddings-surge` for a caching trial.

Jamie: Customer impact:
- No production traffic will go to paused canaries.
- Active canaries keep running their checks; only new allocations are prevented.
- Enterprise exceptions allowed but must route through @Release Council.

Jamie: Steps for owners:
- If your service is `text-gen-highmem`, cancel pending canary assignments and retry after 12:45 UTC.
- Check metrics: mark rollouts for rollback if p50/p95/p99 deltas exceed thresholds.
- Quick healthcheck: `curl -s https://int-metrics.redwood.internal/canary/status?service=<svc>`

Sophia: Jamie - what's the precise rollback gating? We saw p95 spike ~80ms earlier.

Jamie: Use conservative gating for this event: p50 +40ms, p95 +60ms, p99 +90ms. If p95 > +60ms for 3 consecutive 1m windows, trigger auto-rollback.

Leo: How do I list `exp/low` labelled canaries?

Jamie: `./ops/tools/canaryctl list --label exp/low --region us-west-2`
If you lack permissions, ask Release Council for a short-lived grant.

deploy-bot: ops-scheduler executed slot reassignments at 12:07 UTC - 2 slots freed in us-west-2, embeddings-surge assigned to slot-3 (run-id: a1f7c9). :robot_face:

Release Council: Eviction completed cleanly, no user-facing errors reported. Please log exceptions and any Deviations in the rollout ticket for follow-up.

Jamie: TL;DR: pause new `text-gen-highmem` canaries in us-west-2 for ~2 hours, follow the gating thresholds above, exceptions via @Release Council. Will update when pause is lifted. :eyes:
